title: Devilfoil Mask

sources.title: Infernal Legion
markers: | summary = '''Infernal Legion''' is a passive feature that makes the wearer a part of the legion.

summary: When another creature wearing a Devilfoil Mask is within 20 m (about 66 ft), gain +1 Strength and lose 1 Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma per nearby mask.

fields.Crafting: Dammon can turn these masks into Orthon Explosives.
fields.Base value: 50 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
